posts.name: Theta_Sigma
posts.cooked:
HikariStarshine:

OK, we're in the final stretch (especially since GenCon is over now)…  So let's do this thing!  Anything the first-time booth monkeys need to know, going into the con?  Or is that going to be covered at the meet-and-greet on thursday night?

Have some kind of hand sanitiser nearby, and use it often.

Make sure you drink a lot of water, and don't forget to eat.

Get used to playing the same setup over and over, so find ways to ham it up and keep it fun! You don't want to be boring people who've never played just because this is the 50th time you've played this setup today.
